reflection: Across two rounds nothing has passed; most factors help in 2023 and 2025 but fail in 2024, and single-day Apple-only shape features (close position, gap) mostly help only LR. Peer-based signals (MSFT/NVDA moves, dispersion) show some RF life. I will try peer-lead and volume-based ideas, smoothed or scaled by volatility, and avoid near-copies of existing return/MA features. Volume signals and cross-asset volume are untested, so I will try them.

lessons.name: aapl_close_position_mean3
lessons.lesson: Smoothing the close position over 3 days diluted the single-day signal and became similar to short-term mean returns, so it hurt RF and failed in 3 of 4 years.

lessons.name: aapl_gap_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Scaling the gap by volatility helped LR in 2022 but RF overfit the ratio's heavy tails, so it flipped negative in 2023-2024.

lessons.name: aapl_range_position_20d
lessons.lesson: It was effectively a near-copy of close_to_ma20 (0.93), so it added no information and just added noise.

lessons.name: peer_dispersion_1d
lessons.lesson: Absolute MSFT-NVDA disagreement is new information that helped RF in three years, but its effect was unstable in 2024 when peers moved in a strong trend.

lessons.name: aapl_up_volume_signed
lessons.lesson: The formula used an invalid placeholder input, so it was never tested; rebuild it using valid volume ratios.

lessons.name: qqq_close_to_ma20_gap
lessons.lesson: QQQ distance from its MA20 duplicates QQQ 5d return trend and flips sign across regimes (bad in 2022), so it added little.

factors.name: peer_dispersion_z20
factors.hypothesis: Raw dispersion failed in 2024 because its level scales with the volatility regime; z-scoring against the last 20 days makes it regime-neutral while keeping the RF-useful peer disagreement information.

factors.name: aapl_close_position_range_sign_vol
factors.formula: multiply(subtract(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_Close, AAPL_Low), subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low)), 0.5), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), rolling_mean(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), 20)))
factors.hypothesis: Close position was noisy because it ignores whether the range was large; weighting by relative range size emphasises days with meaningful intraday conviction and should stabilise 2024.

factors.name: aapl_signed_volume_surge
factors.hypothesis: High-volume up days versus high-volume down days indicate accumulation or distribution that may continue or reverse the next day; volume is only used unsigned in existing factors.

factors.name: nvda_qqq_volume_ratio_change
factors.hypothesis: Unusual NVDA trading activity relative to the broad tech market signals sector risk appetite shifts or rotation that may affect Apple the next day.

factors.name: aapl_rel_peer_volume_gap
factors.hypothesis: When peers disagree strongly, Apple's 3-day performance relative to the peer average may mean revert more; this gives the dispersion factor a directional relative-move partner.

factors.name: msft_lead_qqq_residual
factors.hypothesis: MSFT's idiosyncratic move versus QQQ is a peer-lead signal that complements Apple's close location: a weak close with MSFT strength could indicate catch-up next day.
